name: a policy written in the older spelling applies
about: A port policy keyed pitchbend and aftertouch, the spellings rig/board/alsa.mjs used, governs bend and touch exactly as the current names would.
notes: synth's policy is { pitchbend: deny, aftertouch: confirm }. Through canonKind that is bend deny and touch confirm. Every other kind takes the default, allow.
t 0: a note 90 3C 64 is allowed and delivered.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 1: bend E0 00 40 is denied. Read verbatim, the key pitchbend matches no kind, so bend would fall to the default and be delivered.
t 2: channel pressure D0 30 is touch, so it is held. synth holds 1.
t 3: poly pressure A0 3C 20 is touch too, held. synth holds 2.
t 4: confirm synth releases both, oldest first, at t 4: D0 30, then A0 3C 20. synth holds 0.
t 5: CC B0 01 40 has no policy and is allowed.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 6: bend E0 7F 7F is denied, so the deny holds after a confirm too.
